ingestionPipeline.description: Future sample ingestion supports: local folders, user-provided packs, CC0/public-domain assets, properly licensed commercial assets
ingestionPipeline.scanFolder: SampleBank.scanFolder(path) — scans a directory for WAV/AIFF/FLAC/MP3, decodes, classifies by acoustic features
ingestionPipeline.classify: Automatic classification by spectral centroid, energy bands, zero-crossing rate, duration
ingestionPipeline.licensePolicy: NEVER assume a random downloaded sample is commercially usable. All imported samples MUST have explicit license metadata.
